content.title: Color Palettes for Audio Plugin UI Design
content.overview: Comprehensive color palette collections and guidelines for creating professional audio plugin interfaces.

glassmorphism.description: Leading trend featuring frosted glass effects with transparency and background blur
characteristics: Semi-transparent panels with subtle blur effects
Pastel or neutral accent colors against blurred backgrounds

dark_theme_dominance.description: Most modern synth UIs use darker interfaces to reduce eye strain
examples: Minimal Audio Current 2.0 - darker, modern look
Serum 2 Dark Blue skin - emphasizes clarity and reduced eye fatigue
ABYSS by Dawesome - dark, cinematic aesthetics

contrast_requirements.wcag_aa: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for UI components

accessibility.sufficient_contrast: Ensure text is readable against backgrounds
accessibility.color_alone: Don't rely solely on color - use icons and labels

implementation_tips.gradients: Use subtle gradients for depth without overwhelming
implementation_tips.glow_effects: Apply believable glow for active elements
implementation_tips.state_changes: Clear visual feedback for hover, active, disabled states
implementation_tips.performance: Optimize blur effects - can impact older systems

tools: Adobe Color CC - creating harmonious dark themes
Coolors.co - quick palette generation with contrast checking
Alien Instruments Contrast Checker - designed for audio software
